rv.q: White Rabbit Red Rabbit is a wildly entertaining and still very current production, wholly unique and well worth seeing.
All in all, White Rabbit Red Rabbit is a deeply moving and, at times, thrilling theatrical experiment.
However, while all those questions are valid, they come across as a bit too pedantic, and the audience participation duplicates déjà-vus of postgraduate drama-devising exercises.

The whole thing felt a little shrouded in mystery, a secret club of those who knew what awaited but were unwilling to share. But would the experience of this show live up to the intrigue that surrounded it, or would the mystery prove more compelling than the play itself?
This simplicity paired with the intimate venue of the Duchess Theatre creates the perfect playful environment for this bold theatrical experience.

cn.t: Critics praise this audacious theatrical experiment for its engaging concept and bold execution. The unique format—featuring unrehearsed actors performing sight unseen—delivers a compelling and inventive experience.

lo.inst: Enter draw via TodayTix app only. Performances only on occasional Mondays.
